# bbsrgeo

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

`bbsrgeo` downloads the **area crosswalks** ("Umstiegsschluessel") for
municipalities and districts published by the BBSR (Bundesinstitut fuer
Bau-, Stadt- und Raumforschung, Germany's Federal Institute for Research on
Building, Urban Affairs and Spatial Development), and uses them to convert
German regional statistics time series (e.g. from the Regionaldatenbank
Deutschland / GENESIS-Regio) onto a consistent, freely chosen set of area
boundaries - despite municipality mergers and district reorganizations.

More background and a worked example: `vignette("bbsrgeo")`.

## Installation

`bbsrgeo` is not (yet) on CRAN. Install from the local source directory:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("local::.")
```

## Example

```{r example}
library(bbsrgeo)

# Which crosswalks does the BBSR offer for districts?
bbsr_crosswalk_available("districts")
```

```r
# Download the crosswalk (cached locally) and read it
path <- bbsr_crosswalk_download(level = "districts", kind = "annual")
crosswalk <- bbsr_crosswalk_read(path)

# Convert regional data (AGS + year + value column) onto the 2024 boundary
harmonize_regions(
  regional_data,
  crosswalk = crosswalk,
  ags_col = "ags",
  year_col = "year",
  value_cols = "population",
  type = "absolute",
  weight = "population",
  target_year = 2024L,
  level = "districts"
)
```
